Nina: PTAL — I addressed the comments on PR #412. Split the flaky-test change into a separate commit, added a focused unit test, and updated the changelog. Rebased on main. Squash vs keep-history: I'm leaning squash to keep the rollout tidy, but can keep history if you prefer. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412

Marcus: Quick skim looks good. Please add a one-line perf expectation in the PR description (tokens/s and p95 latency) so SRE can validate during canary. Also rebase note confirmed, thanks :thumbsup:

Nina: Done — added perf expectations and a short note about fallbacks. Rebased and force-pushed. Small diff snippet: ```diff
- kv_cache: default=32MB
+ kv_cache: default=24MB  # reduce memory during warmup to avoid OOMs
```

Priya: PTAL from release coordination side. Left one nit about a variable name (small). Who's owning merge ops for this one? We need someone to queue the canary for Friday's window.

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved: 2024-11-17 10:00 UTC (reserved by @Priya)

Marcus: I can own merge ops — will queue after CI is green. Heads-up: our policy needs 2 approvals for runtime changes, so we need a second approver.

Li: LGTM, leaving approve now. Good to merge after the canary and CI pass.

Nina: Thanks everyone — re-requesting final PTAL from @Marcus and @Li. CI shows an unrelated macOS flake; monitoring. I'll queue the canary once CI is clear and @Marcus says go.
